request.style: English, Choral, majestic male solo with deep choir, harp, organ, timpani, cello, solemn and awe-inspiring, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The One enthroned in heaven laughs
He mocks the raging kings below
Then he speaks in anger and wrath
Terrifying them as they go

[Pre-Chorus]
I myself have installed my king
Upon Zion my holy mountain

[Chorus]
You are my Son today I have begotten you
Ask of me and I will make the nations yours
The ends of the earth shall be your possession
You are my Son today I have begotten you

[Verse]
Break them with an iron rod
Shatter them like a potter's jar
So now be wise you kings of earth
Be warned you judges far and near

[Chorus]
You are my Son today I have begotten you
Ask of me and I will make the nations yours
The ends of the earth shall be your possession
You are my Son today I have begotten you

[Bridge]
Serve the Lord with fear
Rejoice with trembling

[Chorus]
You are my Son today I have begotten you
Ask of me and I will make the nations yours
The ends of the earth shall be your possession
You are my Son today I have begotten you

[Outro]
I will proclaim the Lord's decree
You are my Son
